strings.error.conversionMismatch: Verification see differences for di converted data. Dem keep di original and backup. Copy fit dey Google; check recovery before you try again.

strings.error.formulaVerification: Di converted spreadsheet get formulas wey di app never fit verify yet. Dem keep di original and backup. For Recovery / backups, choose dis operation and choose Resume as copy to open di spreadsheet for Google without uploading again.
strings.error.generic: No fit complete di operation. Check settings, connection and whether another app open di file. Backups wey dey already still dey available.
strings.error.googleAccess: Google deny access. Check authorization and account/folder permissions. Dem keep di original.
strings.error.googleConversion: Google reject di import or verification export. Dem keep di original. Check diagnostics and recovery before you try again.
strings.error.googleUnavailable: Google no dey available for now or e don limit requests. Dem keep di original. Wait and resume through recovery so you no go upload again.
strings.error.launcherContext: Use ZagoSheetsWin open spreadsheet wey e support. {reason}
strings.error.localConflict: Di file or im association don change. Replacement stop so di versions wey dey already go remain.
strings.error.network: No fit communicate with Google. Check di connection and resume through di app; dem keep di original and one pending operation fit need recovery.
strings.error.reconciliationRequired: Di import dey wait for reconciliation. No upload am again by hand. Check di recovery guide.
strings.error.setupRequired: Complete first-use setup before you open spreadsheets. Open ZagoSheetsWin or im Settings to connect Google and save your preferences.
strings.error.textEncoding: No fit read di CSV/TSV encoding. Use UTF-8 or UTF-16 with BOM; for older files, choose Windows-1252 for text options. Dem keep di original.
strings.error.textStructure: Di CSV/TSV empty or e get rows, delimiters or quotes wey no match. Check di delimiter and file structure. Dem keep di original.
strings.error.xlsConversion: No fit convert dis XLS to XLSX. Dem keep di original and backup.
